reviews.author: Marcus T.
reviews.text: Best multi-cultural barbershop in Vegas. Mir always delivers the cleanest skin fade and razor lineup. Clean shop, friendly vibe, and zero hassle.

reviews.author: Devon K.
reviews.text: Hairanesa is unmatched with braids and tapers! Tight lines, painless styling, and great energy. My go-to spot.

reviews.author: Jordan M.
reviews.text: Major Fadez hooked me up with a crisp drop fade and beard sculpt. Hot towel was refreshing. Highly recommend Crowd Pleezers!

faqs.q: Do you accept walk-ins or are appointments required?
faqs.a: Walk-ins are welcomed Tuesday through Saturday from 9:00 AM to 4:00 PM! To guarantee immediate chair availability with your preferred barber, we recommend reserving on Booksy.

faqs.q: Where are you located and is there parking available?
faqs.a: We are located at 4960 W Charleston Blvd, Las Vegas, NV 89146 in Charleston Decatur Center. We have ample, free parking directly in front of the shop.

faqs.q: Do you offer braiding and locs services?
faqs.a: Yes! Hairanesa specializes in professional men's and women's cornrows, protective braid styling, and loc maintenance alongside master precision tapers.
We accept all major credit/debit cards (Visa, Mastercard, AMEX, Discover), Apple Pay, Google Pay, Booksy direct pay, and cash.

faqs.q: What is included with a signature haircut?
faqs.a: Every signature haircut includes a consultation, precision clipper/scissor cut, hot lather razor neck cleanup, hair styling with premium products, and aftershave tonic.
